g.aria-label: Bench check on a Compute Blade, before power
housings on their headers, plugs free, card out of its slot
If the Compute Blade is on, ask Tim, then power off the Compute Blade: unplug its PoE
cable, and a USB-C cable if one is plugged in.
one probe on contact 1 (GND) of a plug
Contact 1 of each plug to the shell: the meter must beep.
Contact 6 of each plug (VCC, cut back): silent to the shell and to every other contact.
The plug and the meter are sketched. The shell being ground is not measured on this host.
